# Lesson coverage

Baseline: main 8c86814 had 12 Rust, 12 Go and 5 SQL lessons (29 total). Python #38 merged during implementation with ten starter-to-capstone tasks. This expansion adds 159 exercises for 198 total; legacy IDs and task text are retained. No progress migration is required.

Categories are task themes independent of difficulty: numbers, games, text, collections, files, web, data, tooling, concurrency, testing and general. Rust now has 15 First steps and 30 Beginner exercises.

Counts include retained lessons. Concepts list new exercise topics; retained foundations are named separately below. Difficulty levels: 1 first steps, 2 beginner, 3 intermediate, 4 advanced, 5 challenging.

Retained Rust/Go foundations: greetings, variables, functions, loops, borrowing/slices, structs, fallible totals, iterators/interfaces/tests, word counting and concurrent reports. Retained SQL: select, anti-join, paid aggregation, deterministic window ranking and transaction/client recovery.

Python #38 landed during implementation; its ten-task starter-to-capstone track and IDs are preserved. Java, C#, YAML and their ecosystem lessons remain gated on their language tickets. HTML/CSS and JavaScript are now on main and receive tracks here. Go third-party frameworks remain with their language/library ticket; these lessons use supported standard libraries plus the existing database/sql companion.
